title: rundev manifest
description: Local dev services of a repo for the opencode-rundev plugin (.opencode/rundev.json).

default.description: Services a bare `up` starts. An entry may carry a target: "app@ios".

device.description: Optional. Device the launch lands on (emulator-5554, a simulator UDID, chrome). Omit it and rundev resolves the connected/booted device from `requires` and passes -d automatically.

envSection.description: The .env section this target requires (verified only, never written by rundev).

launch.description: Command to type into the panel (defaults to the service `up`).

check.description: Check for this target (exit 0 = up); takes precedence over the service `check`.

requires.description: Services that must be up first (emulator, simulator, api…).

port.description: Port the service listens on (compose: the published host port). Preflighted before every start: a taken port blocks the service instead of starting on top of it.

cwd.description: Working directory relative to the repo root.

health.description: Health URL, probed with curl when there is no `check`.

service.description: kind compose: service name inside the compose file.

device.description: kind simulator: device name or UDID (`xcrun simctl list`).

stopMode.description: wait (default) or send the stop signal and return.

waitMs.description: How long a booting service may take before it counts as unhealthy (default 60000; emulators 180000, simulators 90000).

requires.description: Services that must be up first, of any kind (web requires api; browser requires web). A cycle is an error.
